newsitem.title: UK: UK's Railtrack shares firm after results.
newsitem.headline: UK's Railtrack shares firm after results.

text.p: Shares in British rail infrastructure operator, Railtrack Group, advanced 3-1/2 pence to 649 after the company reported better than expected 1996 profits, dealers said.
Railtrack's pre-tax profit rose to 346 million stg, while most industry analysts had expected a figure around 302 million stg.
"They were better than most expectations," said one dealer.
Railtrack said there had been a reduction in train delays, counted in minutes, by about 38 percent last year, while the figures for passenger services as a whole had improved by about 30 percent.
The company said it would co-operate with train operating companies to promote growth in both passenger and freight rail traffic.
